More tips
RSI / RL ENVIRONMENT MOAT
The site becomes a training environment, not just an uploaded file.

RSI means Reference State Initialization: Origin turns your customer-owned site into many realistic robot starting states and tasks. The verification run then evaluates whether the robot should finish, escalate, or refuse before it earns live authority.

01
Customer site context

Floor plans, walkthroughs, photos, SOPs, links, and notes define the real operating world.

02
Site representation

Origin builds the best available 2D map today and preserves evidence for richer 3D reconstruction.

03
Task planner

The site becomes many start / item / drop / obstacle / restricted-zone tasks for the robot.

04
Evidence-backed verification

A rule-based environment labels finish, escalate, or refuse. The model never grades itself.

05
Supervised run

Labels, rewards, counterfactuals, and hard negatives become training and evaluation signal.

06
Deployment evidence

Teams get refuse recall, unsafe- / missed-action rates, trace proof, and a measured readiness boundary.
